categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: food safety rapid testing and animal diagnostics. It also had a third segment in in vitro diagnostics, which was significantly scaled down in 2023 due to market challenges. The food safety segment includes rapid test reagents, instruments, and related services, while the animal diagnostics segment covers products for livestock and pets, including disease detection and health management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages rapid detection technologies based on chemical and biological methods, including colloidal gold immunochromatography, ELISA, fluorescence PCR, and nucleic acid extraction kits. It has developed proprietary antigen and antibody production platforms, high-efficiency sample pre-treatment technologies such as rapid solid phase extraction (SPE), and integrated automated nucleic acid extraction and detection systems. The company maintains a closed-loop system encompassing core raw materials, reagents, instruments, and detection solutions, supported by extensive R&D and quality management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government regulatory agencies, food production and processing enterprises, trade companies, and third-party testing institutions. The company serves markets related to food safety monitoring, agricultural product quality control, livestock and pet health management, and international dairy and agricultural sectors. Major end markets span domestic Chinese provinces and over 60 countries globally, including Russia, South Korea, India, South America, Europe, Africa, and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic market penetration across multiple provinces. It also has a broad international presence with sales networks covering more than 60 countries and regions across Asia, Europe, Africa, and the Americas. Key international markets include Russia, South Korea, India, Ecuador, Colombia, and emerging markets in Latin America and South Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the development, production, and sales of rapid detection reagents, instruments, and diagnostic services. It controls core raw material production such as antigens and antibodies, enabling vertical integration within its product lines. It does not engage in upstream raw material extraction but manages procurement of chemical reagents and consumables.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company is focusing on consolidating and expanding its food safety rapid testing business while aggressively developing the animal diagnostics segment. R&D priorities include enhancing core antigen-antibody technologies, improving sample pre-treatment methods, developing high-throughput multiplex detection products, and advancing automation and digitalization of testing platforms. The company also emphasizes international certification and standardization efforts to support global market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of rapid testing reagents, diagnostic instruments, and related testing services. The company employs a buyout sales model with direct sales to food producers, government agencies via bidding, and trade companies. It does not use distributor or franchise models. Revenue streams include product sales and service fees for testing and technical support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in the food safety rapid testing and animal diagnostics sectors, recognized as a national high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise. It holds a competitive advantage through proprietary core technologies and a comprehensive product ecosystem. While specific competitors are not named, the company faces challenges from international and domestic firms in the in vitro diagnostics space, which it has scaled down due to market pressures.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 254 million, a 63% decline from the previous year, primarily due to the contraction of the in vitro diagnostics business. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 184.9 million, reflecting a significant loss. Despite the downturn, the company’s food safety rapid testing and animal diagnostics segments showed growth, with animal diagnostics revenue increasing over 230%. Total assets were about RMB 1.36 billion with equity of RMB 849 million. The company is investing in new production facilities and R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes rapid, accurate, and sensitive detection technologies that enable on-site food safety and animal health monitoring. Its unique value lies in proprietary antigen and antibody production, high-efficiency sample pre-treatment, and integrated testing solutions that reduce detection time and complexity. The company’s products have received multiple international certifications, supporting global market acceptance. It offers customized, high-throughput multiplex testing kits and digitalized laboratory platforms, differentiating itself through technological innovation and comprehensive service capabilities.
